source_provenance.question: Below is the graph of a trigonometric function. What is the period of the function? Give an exact value.
source_provenance.previous_model_response:
The points \(\left(\frac{2\pi}{3},8\right)\) and \(\left(\frac{4\pi}{3},8\right)\) are consecutive midline crossings in opposite directions, so their horizontal separation is half a period:

\[
\frac{T}{2}=\frac{4\pi}{3}-\frac{2\pi}{3}=\frac{2\pi}{3}.
\]

Thus,

\[
T=2\left(\frac{2\pi}{3}\right)=\frac{4\pi}{3}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{4\pi}{3}}
\]
